parts.text: In this experiment, you will determine the density of modelling clay by two methods.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Method 1. Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 1.1. You are provided with a piece of modelling clay. Fig. 1.1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Mould the piece of modelling clay into a shape that is approximately a cube. Measure the height h , width w and depth d of the piece of modelling clay. h = ................................................ cm w = ................................................ cm d = ................................................ cm

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the volume V of the piece of modelling clay using the equation V = hwd . V = ............................................... cm 3

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Measure the mass m of the piece of modelling clay using the balance provided. m = ................................................... g

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Calculate the density ρ of the modelling clay using the equation ρ = m V . ρ = ................................................. [3]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Method 2. Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 1.2. You are provided with a beaker containing water at room temperature. Fig. 1.2 Break the piece of modelling clay into two pieces with one piece approximately twice the size of the other piece.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Using the smaller piece of modelling clay, measure its mass m s . m s = ......................................................

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Pour approximately 50 cm 3 of water into the measuring cylinder. Record the volume of water V 1 in the measuring cylinder. V 1 = ......................................................

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Tie the thread around the smaller piece of modelling clay and lower it into the measuring cylinder until it is completely covered with water. Record the new volume V 2 . V 2 = ......................................................

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Calculate the volume V s of the modelling clay using the equation V s = V 2 – V 1 . V s = ......................................................

parts.label: v
parts.text: (v) Calculate the density ρ of the modelling clay using the equation ρ = m s V s . ρ = ..................................................[5]
